map.耿贝尔（Gumbel）极值Ⅰ型：设计值 x_T = x̄ + K·σ；离均系数: Gumbel extreme-value Type I: design value x_T = x\u0304 + K\u00b7\u03c3; frequency factor K = \u2212(\u221a6/\u03c0)\u00b7[0.5772 + ln(\u2212ln(1 \u2212 1/T))], where x\u0304 is the series mean, \u03c3 is the standard deviation, and T is the return period (years).
map.防洪频率分析采用 Gumbel 适线法：将年最大洪峰系列排序后，按极值Ⅰ型分布估: Flood frequency analysis uses the Gumbel fitting method: sort the annual maximum flood peak series and estimate the design peak by the extreme-value Type I distribution. Given a return period T (e.g., 100-year event), obtain x_T = x\u0304 + K\u00b7\u03c3 from the frequency factor K. With short samples (<30 years) results are for reference only; combine with regional synthesis or hydrologic analogy interpolation.

map.重现期怎么理解？: How to interpret the return period?
map.百年一遇指任意年份发生概率 1%，并非百年仅一次；长序列里可能多年连发也可能长期: A "100-year event" means a 1% probability in any given year, not once per century; in a long record it may occur in consecutive years or not appear for a long time.
map.样本偏短怎么办？: What if the sample is too short?
map.系列少于 30 年时 Gumbel 尾部估计不确定性大，宜结合地区综合法或水文比: With fewer than 30 years, Gumbel tail estimates are highly uncertain; combine with regional synthesis or hydrologic analogy interpolation, and treat results as reference only.
